chunks.title: UnBoundX Admin Dashboard — Overview
chunks.text: UnBoundX Admin Dashboard (Full Stack, 2024, Shipped): An internal admin dashboard for managing users, content and analytics with role-based access control.

chunks.title: UnBoundX Admin Dashboard — Technologies
chunks.text: Approach: React front end talking to a Node.js/Express API, with role-based permissions gating dashboard views and MongoDB as the data store. Technologies: React, Node.js, MongoDB

chunks.title: Bank Management System — Overview
chunks.text: Bank Management System (Full Stack, 2023, Academic): A full-stack banking simulation covering accounts, transactions and statements, built on a Java/Spring backend.

chunks.title: Bank Management System — Technologies
chunks.text: Approach: Spring Boot service layer over a SQL schema for accounts and transactions, with a focus on correctness of the transaction/statement logic. Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, SQL

chunks.title: WAGAN SHOP — Overview
chunks.text: WAGAN SHOP (Full Stack, 2021, Internship project): A full-stack e-commerce application built during an internship — product catalog, cart/checkout flow, user authentication and product management.

chunks.title: WAGAN SHOP — Technologies
chunks.text: Approach: React front end, Node.js/Express REST APIs, MongoDB for the product/user data, and JWT-based authentication. Technologies: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT

chunks.title: Coverless Image Steganography — Overview
chunks.text: Coverless Image Steganography (Research, 2025, Research): Research on a cloud-enabled coverless image steganography system for secure data transmission, presented at CoCole 2025, NIT Rourkela.

chunks.title: Coverless Image Steganography — Technologies
chunks.text: Approach: Combines computer-vision feature mapping (OpenCV) with AWS S3 and Lambda to secure data transmission without embedding data directly into a cover image, preserving image integrity. Technologies: Python, OpenCV, AWS S3, AWS Lambda

chunks.title: Multi-Waveform Generator — Overview
chunks.text: Multi-Waveform Generator (Embedded, 2024, Academic): An STM32-based embedded systems project generating and validating multiple waveform outputs, developed during an embedded systems internship.

chunks.title: Multi-Waveform Generator — Technologies
chunks.text: Approach: Built with STM32CubeIDE and Embedded C using HAL libraries, with UART communication and oscilloscope-based signal testing. Technologies: STM32CubeIDE, Embedded C, HAL, UART, Oscilloscope

chunks.title: about intro
chunks.text: Abhishek Kumar Sharma is a frontend and full-stack developer from Jharkhand, India, with experience across React.js, JavaScript, Node.js, Spring Boot, MySQL, MongoDB and AWS.

chunks.title: about current role
chunks.text: Abhishek is currently a Frontend Developer Intern at Infopulse Technology, building responsive React interfaces and integrating REST APIs.

chunks.title: skills backend

chunks.title: skills overview
chunks.text: Core technologies: React, JavaScript, Java, Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, MongoDB, MySQL, SQL, AWS (S3, Lambda), Tailwind CSS, Git and GitHub. Project work also involved Python, OpenCV, STM32, Embedded C, HAL and UART.

chunks.title: projects overview
chunks.text: Abhishek has built the UnBoundX Admin Dashboard (React/Node.js/MongoDB), a Bank Management System (Java/Spring Boot/SQL), WAGAN SHOP — an e-commerce app built during an internship (React/Node.js/MongoDB/JWT), a coverless image steganography research project (Python/OpenCV/AWS, presented at CoCole 2025, NIT Rourkela), and a Multi-Waveform Generator built on STM32 during an embedded systems internship.

chunks.title: recruiter why hire
chunks.text: Abhishek's portfolio demonstrates hands-on experience with React, Node.js, Spring Boot and MongoDB through real projects and internships, along with cloud exposure (AWS) via a published research project at NIT Rourkela. His work spans frontend, backend, database and embedded systems, showing he can operate across the stack rather than in a single lane. The best way to judge fit for a specific role is to review the Projects section or his resume directly.

chunks.title: recruiter strengths
chunks.text: Based on the verified portfolio, Abhishek's strengths are: full-stack web development (React/Node.js/Spring Boot), REST API design with JWT authentication, and applied AWS cloud usage in a research context. He has also worked with embedded systems (STM32) and computer vision (OpenCV), which is less common alongside typical web development experience.
